caption: The drawing depicts a male human figure seated inside a dark, angular, box-like structure with a peaked roof. The figure is shown with tan skin marked by numerous red spots or sores distributed over his face, arms, torso, and legs. He has short black hair, a beard, and mustache, and is wearing a necklace with a cross. The man is seated with his left arm propped up, resting his cheek on his left hand, and his right hand resting on his thigh. The figure is mostly nude except for green shorts and black socks or shoes. He sits on a set of three small, green, rectangular steps inside the structure. The box or enclosure around him is gray with a metallic appearance, featuring simple hinges or latches on either side. The background is plain and unmarked, highlighting the central figure and the enclosure. The artist's signature and date, “A. H. Raynaud 1888,” appear at the bottom right of the drawing.
title: Santo Bulto
